successCriteria.description: src/shared/error.types.ts exports NotFoundError, ValidationError, and ConflictError classes, each extending the native Error with correct prototype-chain setup (Object.setPrototypeOf) so instanceof checks work reliably

src/shared/base.repository.ts exports a generic IBaseRepository<T> interface declaring findById(id: string): Promise<T | null>, findAll(): Promise<T[]>, create(entity: Omit<T, 'id'>): Promise<T>, update(id: string, entity: Partial<T>): Promise<T>, delete(id: string): Promise<void>

src/shared/base.repository.ts exports an abstract BaseKnexRepository<T extends { id: string }> class that accepts a Knex instance and tableName via constructor and provides concrete implementations of all five IBaseRepository<T> methods using Knex query builder
Jest unit tests exist in tests/unit/shared/error.types.test.ts verifying each error class: extends Error, correct name/message, correct instanceof discrimination between error types

Jest unit tests exist in tests/unit/shared/base.repository.test.ts verifying BaseKnexRepository: findById returns entity or null, findAll returns array, create inserts and returns entity, update patches and returns entity, delete removes by id

constraints: TypeScript strict mode — no implicit any, strict null checks (from HARNESS.json constraints.rules: no-any)
BaseKnexRepository<T> must accept a Knex instance via constructor injection and a tableName string; all five IBaseRepository<T> methods must be implemented using the Knex query builder
Error classes must use Object.setPrototypeOf(this, XxxError.prototype) in their constructors for correct instanceof behaviour across prototype chains
Tests must use Jest and be placed in tests/unit/shared/ — one test file per source file (error.types.test.ts, base.repository.test.ts)
No circular dependencies — shared layer must not import from any module under src/modules/
outOfScope: Concrete repository implementations (KnexLeaveRepository, KnexLeaveBalanceRepository, etc.) — these are Phase 2+
Any domain models, services, controllers, or routes — these belong to later phases
Knex migrations or seed files — Phase 6
